information.description:
A small subsect of commandos among Barghest have dropped their professional training to drown themselves in the lifestyle of the underworld. They’re hand-to-hand specialists, interrogators, and efficient monsters that would love to bite your face off.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Barghest).
information.notes:
Threat level: Elite Hardened Mini-Boss
Facedown #: 10
COM#: 16

Weapons:

  • Heavy Throwing Knife: ROF 2, 2d6. x2, Can be thrown as half of a ROF 2 Action, and still halve the target’s SP when thrown; thrown (built on the core Medium Melee)
  • Gorilla Arm (EQ Heavy Melee) [x2]: ROF 2, 3d6 (Gorilla Arm)

Armor:

  • Subdermal Armor: SP 13 as printed (the item is SP 11); Heavy Subdermal Plating, which has no Foundry item: built as Subdermal Armor at its printed SP
  • Melee SP (head/body): 7/7

Situational skill values:

  • Athletics 16 (14)
  • Brawling 18 (16)
  • Evasion 16 (14)
  • Melee Weapon 18 (16)

Not built:

  • Self-ICE (in Neural Link): from official Cyberpunk RED material by R. Talsorian Games; not in the Cyberpunk RED - Core Foundry system

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
A cybernetical replacement arm. Comes with a free hand.

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 7 (4d6/2 [Round Up])

Outfitted with kinetic energy recovery systems, these upgraded replacements for natural limbs improve strength and endurance.

Cyberarm Option. Requires 2 Option Slots. The user can wield this cyberware’s reinforced fist as an Excellent Quality Heavy Melee Weapon which uses the Brawling Skill. This arm ignores the BODY related penalties of weapons with a BODY requirement of 11 or less, and the user may wield Melee Weapons in this arm’s hand as if they had BODY 11. When purchased twice and installed in two paired Cyberarms, the user can also pry open doors/move Thick Cover, Choke, and Slam as if they had BODY 11.

Type: Cyberarm
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 2

Foundry notes:

  • Corgo's Humanity Loss is 4d6 halved, rounding up. CPR can only roll a plain dice formula for humanity loss, so the rolled option is 2d6: same 2-12 range and same average of 7, a slightly flatter spread. Pick the static 7 at install if you'd rather not roll.
  • Cyberware items have no Quality field, so the Excellent Quality is in the text only.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberarms).

Built-in hydraulics negates penalty for jumping. Must be paired.

Built-in hydraulics negates penalty for jumping. Must be paired.
Deals no damage. If hit roll DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs. On a fail take the Damaged Eye and Damaged Ear Critical injuries (see pg. 188) for 1 minute. No Crit damage dealt.
Increase Body by 2 (and related stats). Stacks. Max at 10 Body.
Handcuffs meant for borgs. Disables any Non-Hardened Cyberware options installed in the limb the cuffs are binding. BODY≥13 can break.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

The modern Kerenzikov takes the place of the now defunct Reflex Co-Processor to help reduce the strain on the user's Neuroport.

Neuralware. The user can now dodge Ranged Attacks if they could not do so already, and gain a +2 bonus to Checks for noticing Ambushes.

NOTE: Credit to Infernox_Ratchet for the basis of this item.

Type: Neuralware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Replaces the core system's Kerenzikov; use this one instead of the core item.
  • The +2 is on Perception and situational, because it only applies to noticing an Ambush: tick it in the roll dialog.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

If you want to stay in the game, you’re going to need a boost.

Kerenzikov Cyberware Enhancement. The Kerenzikov now counts as Speedware and also provides a +2 bonus to initiative at all times. Only 1 piece of Speedware can be installed at a time.

Enhances: Kerenzikov
Option Slots: 0 (Cyberware Enhancement)

Foundry notes:

  • The +2 initiative isn't automated from an upgrade; add it to the Kerenzikov as an Active Effect (bonuses.initiative) or apply it by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).
